column2: External Playlist Signal — Making Sense of the Noise
Generated 2026-07-11 from SC-EXTERNAL-PLAYLISTS.csv (2268-track full scrape universe, snapshot run 2026-07-10/11)
What this is
3,449 track-playlist pairs: every case found of one of your tracks sitting inside someone else's SoundCloud
playlist. SoundCloud never notifies you of this, so it's the closest thing to a 'someone chose my song'
signal available. Most of it is noise. This workbook sorts the signal from it.
Method
Every row was scored on two axes: how tightly curated the playlist is (playlist_track_count) and whether
the curator has a real audience (owner_followers_count). A third check — what share of that playlist IS
your tracks — caught something the two-axis model alone would have missed: 3 playlists with 200+ tracks
turned out to be superfans who mirrored your ENTIRE catalog into their own playlist, not generic dumps.
Without that check, 1,146 rows (a third of the dataset) would have been wrongly written off as noise.
Tiers
Tier
Catalog Mirror (Superfan)
column4: Playlist has 100+ tracks AND >=50% of them are yours. A fan cloned your whole discography. Strongest signal in the dataset — see 'Catalog Mirrors' tab.

column2: Priority Curator
column4: Small playlist (<=30 tracks) + curator has a real audience (50+ followers). Genuine, deliberate pick by someone with reach. See 'Priority Curators' tab.

column2: Repeat Curator
column4: Same person added your tracks to 2+ different playlists of theirs. Recurrence is itself a signal regardless of size/followers. See 'Repeat Curators' tab.

column2: Niche/Emerging Curator
column4: Small playlist, but curator has few/no followers. Real curation, just no audience yet. Included in Full Data, not broken out separately.

column2: Mid-size Playlist
column4: 31-199 tracks. Ambiguous middle — could be real or semi-algorithmic. Included in Full Data only.

column2: Generic Dump (low signal)
column4: 200+ track playlist where your tracks are a small fraction of a big multi-artist mix. Closest thing to real noise here. See 'Dump Playlists (Ignore)' tab.
